We went to Bellerose Animal Hospital for the first time for an unfortunate and heartbreaking reason—to put our beloved baby Roxi to sleep.

Despite the difficult circumstances, we were deeply touched by how clean and welcoming the hospital was. The staff and doctor were incredibly friendly, accommodating, and compassionate throughout the entire process. They treated us with genuine care and kindness during one of the most difficult moments for our family.

What touched us the most was receiving a handwritten sympathy card from the entire staff. That small but incredibly meaningful gesture went above and beyond our expectations. It showed us that they are not there simply as a business, but also to provide comfort, compassion, and support to families when they need it most.

Thank you, Bellerose Animal Hospital, for treating our baby Roxi with dignity and for giving our family so much kindness and comfort during such a painful time. We are truly grateful. 🐾🌈🕊️
The best
Great help, friendly staff, and my dog’s all better!
Thank you for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again!
Very friendly and professional. I feel so reassured as well as my our Princess 👑 …
My cat came in good health and died within 2 weeks of being "treated". Please don't take your pet here if you don't want them to legitimately die.

Bellerose Animal Hospital has been our go-to vet for close to 10 years, and we have had nothing but positive experiences with them. Over the years, they have cared for several of our dogs through everything from routine visits to more serious health issues. Two of our Chihuahuas developed heart conditions, and with the care and guidance we received here, we were fortunate to have many more years with them.

Dr. Hernandez has always been fantastic. She is knowledgeable, thorough, and great about explaining what is going on and what our options are. She also takes her time with the dogs and gives them a chance to get comfortable instead of immediately jumping into the exam. Dr. Taddeo has also been wonderful to work with and has always been patient, caring, and attentive.

One of the things that has always stood out to me about Bellerose is the staff as a whole. The receptionists are friendly and helpful, and the vet techs have always treated our dogs with patience and care. You also see many of the same faces year after year. The fact that so many employees have stayed there for a long time and seem genuinely happy to be there says a lot about the practice.

After nearly a decade of bringing our dogs here, we have developed a lot of trust in the entire team. It is reassuring to know that when one of our dogs needs care, they are in good hands. I would definitely recommend Bellerose Animal Hospital to other pet owners.

We have been bringing all of our pups to Bellerose Animal Hospital for almost 10 years and have always had such a great experience. They helped us manage our Chihuahuas’ heart conditions for many years, and both of our dogs were able to live with their heart conditions for about six years, which we are incredibly grateful for.

Dr. Hernandez is absolutely incredible. She is extremely knowledgeable and always takes the time to make our pets feel comfortable and at ease before beginning an examination. You can tell that she genuinely cares about the animals she treats and never makes you feel rushed.

We also see and love Dr. Taddeo. Both Dr. Hernandez and Dr. Taddeo are patient, kind, compassionate, and truly passionate about caring for animals.

The rest of the staff deserves recognition as well. Everyone at the reception desk is always friendly, helpful, and welcoming, and all of the vet techs we have interacted with have been wonderful with our dogs. Many of the staff members have been there for years, which is really nice to see, and they always seem genuinely happy to be there and willing to help.

After almost a decade of trusting Bellerose Animal Hospital with our dogs, we are so thankful for the care they have provided over the years. We would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate veterinary team that truly cares about both the animals and their families.

My 7yr Pit Bull Bully Pharaoh  had to be brought in today.  Had an appt at 12:20pm....They honored my time! Ms. Aissa the receptionist was wonderful , she saw Dr. Nagsuci, wonderful as well. I WOULD RECOMMEND THIS ESTABLISHMENT TO EVERYONE.
Thank you for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again!
They really care about your pets! Great staff and wonderful Vets!
The girl at the front desk Aissa was so sweet. The doctor was nice to deal with and they took me when no one else was open for the Fourth of July weekend.

I brought my cat to this vet and was always welcomed with warmth and care. He had a heart condition and when I was a nervous wreck, the staff was peaceful and empathetic. Unfortunately, I had to put my cat down in the end. They handled him with such care, it was as if he was a client for years, though I was only going there for 2 months. I really appreciate the service I received and would recommend anyone to bring their pets here.

Compassionate, amazing and most of all, knowledgeable staff and doctors.

Bellerose Animal Hospital has been such a blessing for our family and pets. For the past 8 years, Dr. Hernandez and her team have cared for my dog and cat with so much kindness, patience, and expertise. The staff is always welcoming, knowledgeable, and thorough, and I always feel confident that my pets are in the best hands. It’s clear how much they genuinely care about the animals they treat. I’m so grateful for them and highly recommend this office to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care!

The best experience for our first visit with our Cane Corso puppy. All of the staff and dcotors are super nice and so welcoming. They took auch good care of our boy. Our puppy had the best experience!
Dr. Hernandez and her staff is amazing!

I am very disappointed with my recent experience at Bellerose Animal Hospital.

I brought my cat in because she was vomiting and clearly unwell. After the visit, I left without any treatment, without medication to relieve her symptoms, and without a clear diagnosis. Instead, I was presented with an extensive list of expensive tests that felt excessive and unrealistic for the situation.

What concerned me most was the change in attitude once I explained that I could not afford all of the tests immediately. I felt the level of care and attention dropped noticeably after that conversation.

I later sought a second opinion elsewhere, where my cat was properly examined, given fluids, anti-nausea treatment, and practical care right away.

Also, according to the receipt, the exam charge was $100, but I paid $115 and was not refunded the $15 difference.

As a pet owner, I expected compassion, transparency, and a reasonable treatment plan. Unfortunately, that was not my experience here.

When my beloved dog was diagnosed with mast cell tumor, I figured that was the end of the road for us. And then in came Dr. Christine Taddeo. She was knowledgeable, calm, and confident of her decisions. Moose is about to celebrate one year cancer free and we’re thrilled. I can’t recommend her or BAH enough.
Thank you for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again!
Wonderful doctors, wonderful staff. I work in specialty veterinary medicine and come here for all my family’s pets’ primary care needs!

This was our first visit to Bellerose and the person who referred me couldn’t have described the service more accurately. They were extremely friendly, an inviting atmosphere and the bed manner from James and Dr Hernandez was incredible. They were informative, thorough and helped ensure Rosie was in good hands. Our Rosie was put at ease and after the treatment she’s never been happier. I never thought I’d say this, and don’t want to wish any harm, but I can’t wait for our next visit!

My dog comes here for management of elevated liver enzymes as well as routine vaccines, and we’ve always had a great experience. They are consistently excellent with scheduling and wait times—sometimes we don’t even have time to sit down before we’re called in. Their prices are reasonable, and it’s very convenient that they offer so many services on site. My dog has had routine bloodwork, an abdominal ultrasound, and chest X-rays all done there.
The veterinarians are thorough and reliable about calling us back with results in a timely manner, and they always email the reports so I can review and compare lab values over time. Parking is also easy—they have a small lot in the back that’s usually not full, and if it is, there’s plenty of street parking nearby. Highly recommend.
Thank you for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again!

I just love this vets  office, even tho it’s pricey it’s worth the money I spend on my fur babies. The first time I came it was for an emergency and they took great care of my frenchie. They took her in right away and treated her back to health. The doctors are attentive, compassionate and thorough. The front desk staff is polite, and extremely helpful. They told me because I have 3 dogs that I get a multiple pet discount of 5% on each visit. That 5% goes a long way especially during this economy. Love that I don’t feel pressured into treatment options I don’t want or can’t afford. I recommend this vet to anyone looking for great care for their animals.
Kind and loving care from Dr Hernandez and her staff. Thank you to Anisha and Valentina on this visit. Really appreciate the special touch you extend
They always are so supportive and caring. All the doctors are amazing!
Amazing service! All staff are nice and caring to both the pets and owners. They even went out of their way to make sure everything needed was done for our cat Clover. Please keep up the good work!

Our good friend recommended this animal hospital for our cats, and we are so thankful we took our pets here.  Dr. Hernandez and her staff are so patient and kind to our cats, and the facility is very warm and welcoming when you enter.  The staff here truly cares about animals.

I have been bringing my pets to Dr. Hernandez at Bellerose Animal Hospital for over 20 years, and I truly cannot say enough good things about her. She is one of the most compassionate, knowledgeable, and dedicated veterinarians I’ve ever met. Over the years, she has cared for my pets as if they were her own and she always takes the time to explain everything clearly and making sure they receive the best care possible. The reception staff are also amazing and they are always warm, friendly, and so helpful, which makes every visit easy and stress-free.

Dr. Hernandez goes above and beyond, not just as a veterinarian but as a person who truly loves animals. I have complete trust in her and her team, and my pets have always been in the best hands. She has supported my family through both happy and difficult times with kindness and professionalism.

She’s truly the best, and I’m grateful for her every single day. Anyone who brings their pets to Dr. Hernandez can feel confident they’re in the best hands. Her dedication, kindness, and experience are truly unmatched.

My search for a veterinary hospital skilled in performing laser surgery for stenotic nares brought us to Bellerose Animal Hospital, and I am so glad it did. My 11-month-old Scottish Fold kitten was struggling to breathe, and I specifically wanted the precision and minimal invasiveness of the laser technique.
From our first visit, Dr. Hernandez was outstanding. She was incredibly kind, patient, and knowledgeable. She thoroughly explained the procedure and clearly prioritized my cat's physical and emotional comfort, which instantly put me at ease.

The surgery and recovery went perfectly, and the difference is night and day! My cat is finally able to breathe normally after playing or eating, and it made me realize how long it had been since I heard her truly purr.
Thank you to Dr. Hernandez and the friendly, professional staff at Bellerose for this life-changing care. They are simply the best.

Dr Hernandez and her team were very professional and extremely knowledgeable and supportive
I highly recommend them for your pet
Very nice/clean facility with great customer service! Highly recommend, thank you!!

I originally thought this clinic was great, kind and understanding staff, fair pricing, and a welcoming environment. Unfortunately, the last five years have proven otherwise. This place has become nothing more than a waste of time and, worse, a risk to your pet’s health. Their customer service has declined drastically, and the quality of care has followed the same downward path.

Shockingly, even large chains like Bond Vet now outshine this so-called community clinic in both pricing and care. Imagine that, a chain clinic doing a better job than a neighborhood practice that should be invested in its community. This place is not only ridiculously expensive, but also unhelpful in times of real crisis. They charge outrageous “walk-in fees” during emergencies when appointments aren’t available, and they refuse to give even basic price ranges for surgeries unless you pay for an unnecessary consultation, even if you’ve already done bloodwork, X-rays, and history elsewhere. They force you to pay them simply to get a quote. That is not medicine; it’s predatory business.

The ethics here are beyond questionable. They exploit emergencies, overcharge loyal clients, and withhold transparency. If you value your pet’s health and your peace of mind, skip this clinic entirely. There are many others in our community, myself included, who share the same disappointment and frustration. Your pet deserves better than what this place has become.
Only bring my dog boujie to the best ! Bellerose animal hospital are excellent! Highly recommend for incredibly and exceptional animal care!
Perfect experience! First time bringing our puppy in & he had the most calm demeanor in the clinic. Staff is very accommodating & time efficient. Thank you, Team!

I am visiting from Houston with my poodle, who needs to have his medicine administered. When I arrived, the staff welcomed me warmly. We met Dani, who went above and beyond to explain everything in detail, which helped my poodle. Dani was truly amazing. Thank you!!!!!

This place is terrible. Very unprofessional and terrible service. I ended up having to spend a lot of money to correct the horrible work they did to my dog. Save yourself time, money, and suffering and go somewhere else.
Dr. Hernandez is amazing!

This has been the best experience I’ve had at any vet.
My cat has been very sick, and I had taken her to two other vets in one month (including an emergency hospital), but Bellerose Animal Hospital was by far the most informative and compassionate. My cat had to be hospitalized for a night. They updated me every time there was news, and I truly felt like my little girl was being cared for with love and attention.

Thank you to everyone at this location — from the kind reception staff to the assistants and doctors — each person was incredibly helpful, patient, and informative. I’m so grateful for everything you did for us.

I highly recommend!!!! I’m extremely satisfied and happy with everything about Bellerose Animal Hospital. Dr. Hernandez is absolutely amazing—empathetic, intelligent, and truly dedicated. She helped my dog with a chronic anal gland issue that had been inflamed for months and that no other professional was able to resolve. The laser treatment also made a huge difference. I’m so grateful to the entire team!

I cannot say enough good things about Bellerose Animal Hospital. The staff is extremely compassionate and knowledgeable. My family feels so safe and validated when we bring our pets here. Thank you to all the doctors and amazing staff who have helped us during challenging times with our furry babies. In good and bad medical times, they have treated our pets with utmost care and dignity. Dr. Taddeo is a one of a kind doctor and person. Thank you Dr. Taddeo, Dr. Magsuci, Darline, James, Valentina, Daneyri, and all of the amazing staff who work at Bellerose ❤️❤️❤️
unfortunately, when you have unprofessional staff at front desk it can change everything.  Over 10 years have attended this place with all dogs I have but its time for a change due to front desk.

I wanted to share my experience at Bellrose Animal Hospital, This place deserves a solid 5 stars!  Dr. Hernandez and her staff were the best and helped me throughout my experience with my dog. My baby girl Chanel had Pyometra, which was the scariest thing I've ever experienced, and watching her suffer had me so worried! Before coming here, I did try other spots and felt hopeless because of their lack of empathy and concern. I almost gave up, then my sister came across Bellrose Animal Hospital. Right away, my family and I felt comfortable leaving our dog in their hands. For the first time, I felt safe, I knew they weren't after my money, and really wanted to help Chanel. Dr. Hernandez even brought the bill down due to not having to perform/ do extra stuff during Chanel's surgery. All I know is that Dr. Hernandez and her staff really care! Thank you Dr. Hernandez and staff!!
